title: Compact run metrics cribsheet - Arya
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal reference sheet for micro-run metrics (latency + cost) across small trials. Meant to be a fast lookup during iterative tuning sessions on local dev nodes and small dedicated pools. Not canonical bench results—just my notes.

Legend:
- latency: median p50 (ms) end-to-end for single request (excl client overhead)
- cost_est: rough per-1k-token cost estimate based on batch size & GPU-minute cost
- notes: config flags, anomalies, quick hypothesis

TABLE (most recent runs at top):
run_id, date, model_variant, seq_len, batch, kv_cache, concurrency, latency_ms, cost_est_per_1k, notes
R-1229, 2025-11-12, gptx-7b-q4f, 512, 1, enabled, 1, 98, $0.71, warm kv-cache hit ~80%, small fluctuation on step 4
R-1228, 2025-11-11, gptx-7b-q4f, 128, 8, enabled, 2, 42, $0.18, batching effective, CPU prefetching helped
R-1225, 2025-11-09, gptx-7b-fp16, 1024, 1, disabled, 1, 210, $1.10, long seq penalty, kernel fallback observed
R-1219, 2025-10-30, gptx-3b-q4, 256, 4, enabled, 3, 65, $0.12, good throughput, slight tail latency spikes

Quick takeaways (current):
- q4f quantization + KV cache gives best cost/latency for interactive patterns when seq_len < 600.
- For long contexts (>800) fp16 still outperforms quantized paths on P100-like hardware due to kernel stability.
- Concurrency >2 starts to make p95 drift; monitor worker CPU saturation.

To-dos / experiments to run next sprint:
- "cache-warmup" test: systematically vary warmup prefix sizes (0, 64, 256) and measure 10-run median. Ticket: INF-7342 referenced.
- micro-batch auto-tune: run batch sweep [1,2,4,8] at seq 256, record throughput/latency/cost. Attach run artifacts to PR #2187.
- Verify q4f path on the new 8-bit kernels (compare p95).

Notes-to-self (debug pointers):
- If latency jumps unexpectedly, check: nv_top, iostat on data disk, and redis cache miss counters.
- Use script: scripts/local_bench/run_probe.sh --run-id=R-1230 --trace to capture traces.

Mini visualization (p50 latency trend last 6 runs):
R-1219 ▂ R-1225 ▅ R-1228 ▃ R-1229 ▄ (higher = worse)

Small checklist before sharing results:
- [ ] attach seed prompts set
- [ ] upload raw traces to /tmp/bench-archive (date-stamped)
- [ ] add experiment description to PR

Random scribbles: try increasing mempool 1.2x for q4f path; maybe reduces small GC stalls.

End.
